claims.summary: The lexeme спутник has an animate companion sense and an inanimate celestial-body sense; the dictionary marks it animate and inanimate.
Plural accusative forms of animate nouns align with genitive plural, while inanimate nouns align with nominative plural.
спутники is the inanimate plural form for satellites and спутников the animate accusative plural for companions.
The animacy distinction follows the intended lexical sense and is not an arbitrary choice by the speaker.
In both example clauses the phrase functions as accusative; animacy changes the visible form selected by the paradigm.
